## ① Collect
3 sources, 6 requests. Every fetch retries 3× (2 s apart) and **continues on error**, so a slow or broken source never stops the run.

## ② Normalize
Each source is mapped into the same 16-column schema. Failed/empty sources log **"Source unavailable: …"**.

## ③ Quality checks
Trim text · dates → YYYY-MM-DD · drop records missing title/date/source · remove duplicates · flag incomplete fields.

## ④ Save
CSV of clean records + JSON quality report. Download from the node output, or find them in `/home/node/.n8n-files/`.

// Turn the clean bundle into one item per record, so each record becomes one CSV row.
return $input.first().json.records.map((json) => ({ json }));
